text:
Mina: Heads-up — planning a dedicated capacity config change for rsv-gpu-prod-2 tomorrow 2026-01-10 17:00 UTC (maintenance window 17:00–18:00 UTC). It's an autoscaler tuning + new canary weight. Who can own the deploy/rollback?

Chris: I can take the deploy, will be on-call then. What's the exact rollback play?

Mina: Thanks @Chris. Rollback is simple revert of the pool config in infra-config repo + kubectl apply. Plan:
1) Push config PR and merge at T-15m.
2) Apply canary slice at 10% for 10m.
3) Run smoke checks (see commands below).
4) Monitor dashboards; if p99 latency increases >25% or error rate >0.5% across the canary, roll back immediately.

Smoke checks (run just after canary apply):
```bash
# quick health check
curl -sS https://rsv-gpu-prod-2.health.redwood/api/health | jq .status
# tokenized inference sanity (small model)
curl -sS -X POST https://rsv-gpu-prod-2.api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":8}' | jq .choices[0].text
# pod readiness
kubectl get pods -l pool=rsv-gpu-prod-2 -o wide
```
Also run: `./infra/scripts/smoke.sh --pool rsv-gpu-prod-2 --canary 10` (reports to #eng-sre dashboard).

Jordan: I'll watch the latency, traces, and kv-cache hit rates. Add me to the runbook (I can jump in if we see cold-start spikes).

Sophie: Quick q — does this policy change touch Dedicated burst slots or reserved capacity billing?

Mina: No change to billing or burst slots. This only adjusts autoscaler thresholds and slice weights.

Priya: I opened the infra CR just now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-config/pull/4892 — contains the exact diff and rollback commit. Approvals pending (sec review already done).

Chris: Got the PR. I'll merge at T-15m and start the canary at 17:00 UTC. I'll ping here at each step.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy by Chris for 2026-01-10T17:00:00Z — canary 10% slice rsv-gpu-prod-2.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: watch panels — p99 latency, error-rate, token throughput, GPU utilization. Alert thresholds copied into the runbook.

Mina: If anyone expects to be offline during window, please say now. Otherwise plan: merge -> apply -> canary 10% 10m -> quick smoke -> increase to 50% if green -> monitor 20m -> full cutover. Rollback: revert config and scale back slices to previous commit.

Sophie: I'm online during window, will monitor until full cutover.

Jordan: I'll take first 20m of monitoring after canary.

Priya: Noted, will stand by for rollback PR if needed.

Chris: Merge in 10. Will post live updates. :thumbsup:

Mina: Thanks all — tag @oncall if something pops.

Chris: MERGED and starting canary now (17:00 UTC).

Chris: Canary smoke pass: health ok, sample inference returned, no errors in logs for first 5m.

Jordan: p99 up 8% (expected), error-rate 0.12% — looks good. Continuing to watch.

Chris: Increasing to 50% now (17:12 UTC).

Jordan: No new anomalies. KV cache hit stable. Proceeding with extended monitor.

Mina: If anything degrades, we revert to commit abc123 from PR.

Chris: Full cutover completed at 17:35 UTC. Closing monitoring window at 17:55 UTC unless anyone sees regressions.

Sophie: All good from my side.

Priya: Closing CR in the system.

eng-sre-bot: Post-deploy checks passed. Metrics baseline within thresholds.

Mina: Great job team, thanks for quick coordination.

Chris: Thanks — marking this as done on the checklist.
